name: Hades
short_description: Escape the underworld room by room as the son of Hades, dying and returning with the story moving forward each time.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: Escape the underworld room by room as the son of Hades, dying and returning with the story moving forward each time.

identity.core_loop: Fight a room, pick a god's boon, push deeper, die, return home, talk, upgrade, try again.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Fast, generous, beautifully reactive; failure moves the story on.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: Doors show the reward behind them; enemy wind-ups are readable shapes; characters comment on what just happened. Moderate HUD.

rendering.signature: Painted characters with thick dark outlines and lighting painted in, on lit painted ground.
rendering.source: oracle rendering study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no captures, no game files)
rendering.lesson: Paint the light into the asset when the camera never moves around it.

identity.audio_mood: Rock-mythic score, deep voice work for every character.
identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: Make failure part of the story: every return home has new talk. Characters remember what the player did.
